descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating the city of Jabesh-Gilead (Hebrew Yavesh Gil'ad), a town in Transjordan east of the Jordan River in the territory of Gilead. Notable in the narrative of the Benjaminite war where wives were taken from Jabesh for the surviving Benjaminites (Judg 21:8-14), Saul's rescue of Jabesh from the Ammonite siege (1 Sam 11:1-11), the men of Jabesh retrieving Saul's body from Beth-shan and burying his bones (1 Sam 31:11-13; 2 Sam 2:4-5; 1 Chr 10:11-12), and David's blessing on the men of Jabesh (2 Sam 2:5). Also the patronym of Shallum son of Jabesh who assassinated Zechariah king of Israel (2 Kgs 15:10, 13, 14). All auto-split clusters represent the same toponym with varying prepositions and spelling variants.
